name: HTML Color Codes · Color Picker

title.zh: HTML Color Codes · 拖动取色抄走颜色代码

description.zh: 拉到Color Harmonies，看六组搭配和导出按钮再抄代码。 HTML Color Codes是以取色器为核心的颜色工具站，提供拾色、色轮、图片取色、色表与色名查询及格式转换，输出Hex、RGB、HSL与OKLCH等数值与和谐搭配，运营主体为Wasai LLC。
description.en: HTML Color Codes is a color-tool site built around pickers, offering color picking, color wheel, image color picking, charts, color-name lookup and conversions, with Hex, RGB, HSL and OKLCH values and harmonies; it is operated by Wasai LLC.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by HTML Color Codes (https://htmlcolorcodes.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 拉到Color Harmonies，看六组搭配和导出按钮再抄代码。

Visual details from source observation: 我们落在首页，大标题下是Hex、RGB、HSL和OKLCH数值条，连着渐变取色区和当前色块。先点顶部Picker进去拖动取色，再往下拉看Color Harmonies六组搭配，比单抄一个色值更有用。色表页另有四套预设图表可对照，适合调页面配色时随手查，未见许可声明，拿色值参考即可。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
